title: tetranthera bindoniana
intro: Tetranthera bindoniana, commonly known as New Zealand button fern, is a plant species native to New Zealand and parts of Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Tetranthera bindoniana include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in soothing skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
